newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 2.22 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 2.22 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 2,217,600 pounds of frozen coarse ground pork for distribution in the National School Lunch Program and other federal programs.

AMS said it bought the pork at awarded prices ranging from $1.0529-$1.1166 per pound in the first purchase of coarse ground pork since the program was announced on August 19. Shipments are to be in two periods between October 7 and November 1, 1996.
Winning bidders were American Foods Group (Huron, S.D.) 396,000 lbs, Bo Packing Co (Chicago, Ill.) 831,600 lbs, and Swift and Co (Louisville, Ky.) 990,000 lbs.
